title: Assessing and Addressing Algorithmic Bias – But Before We Get There
findings: This paper does not discuss, analyze, or measure any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on the general challenges of identifying and mitigating algorithmic and data bias in industry settings, using examples from domains like voice interfaces.
